scope.behavior: Capture the original dereferenced CELL before Warning without adding an HCELL owner. On normal return, require the same physical cache cell/key/largest-key INDEX and PAUSED phase, then reread that cell into a fresh private parameter cell. Alias writes affect delivery; real GLOBALS rebinding preserves the old cell. Earlier private cells survive the second Warning.
scope.reference_policy: Reuse ordinary_reference_value plus iterator_unpack_scalar_operand(S, REFERENCE cell) before and after Warning: NULL/bool/int/float/interned strings only. No promotion through KNOWN bypass; typed/backed/debt cells, runtime-string carriers and owning payloads remain Unsupported.

implementation.representation: CELL is optional nat metadata and contributes no task/heap root. HOLD remains a scalar snapshot; BYVAL delivery still checks cached-value equality. INDEX tracks the largest used integer key, not every resumption. Equal key/index/value cannot hide a changed reference cache CELL.
